opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £10,000 to £250,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations, private owners of a heritage asset, and partnerships. Organisations need a bank account, governing document, and two or more members not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £10,000 to £250,000. Funds projects that value, care for and sustain heritage, covering costs such as volunteer expenses, new staff posts, training, capital works, conservation, professional fees, events and acquisition of heritage. No application deadline - open all year round. Projects must not start before a decision is made; decisions aimed within eight weeks.

opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10million
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations and partnerships led by not-for-profit organisations. Organisations need a bank account, governing document, and two or more members not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £250,000 to £10million (with exceptional projects over £10m considered). Applicants must first submit an Expression of Interest, then a development phase application (up to two years) and a delivery phase application (no more than five years). Deadlines are quarterly. For grants under £1m applicants must contribute at least 5% of project costs; for grants over £1m, at least 10%. Heritage Enterprise projects up to £5m.
